test_AutoencoderRAE_encode_decode: test the AutoencoderRAE model by encoding an image tensor and decoding it back to verify output shapes
test_AutoencoderRAE_scaling_factor: test that AutoencoderRAE scaling_factor multiplies latents and produces consistent reconstructions across different scaling values
test_AutoencoderRAE_latents_normalizatio: test that AutoencoderRAE latents_mean and latents_std normalize encoded latents matching the expected formula
test_AutoencoderRAE_slicing_tiling: test that AutoencoderRAE use_slicing produces identical results to non-slicing mode for encode and decode
test_AutoencoderRAE_noise_tau: test that AutoencoderRAE noise_tau adds noise only in train mode and produces deterministic output in eval mode
